# Paid plans

Free tiers run out, and free models are weaker at agentic coding. This section covers what you can pay for instead: **subscriptions** (a flat monthly price for a vendor's own apps and coding tools), **coding-tool plans** (opencode, Cline, Command Code and others), **pay-per-token APIs** (usable from any agent, from your own apps and through the [router](../router/index.md)), and the **free quotas of coding tools** that log in with an account instead of an API key.

40 entries, newest check **2026-11-20**. A row more than 45 days older than the newest check is marked ⏰ stale.

!!! warning "Subscriptions are not API keys"
    Most subscriptions only work inside the vendor's own apps and CLIs. Using a subscription login through a router or a third-party tool is often against its terms. The **Router / API** column says what each plan's own terms allow.
